#HappyJeromeJinnDay

Born side by side as the clock chimed fate,
Seven minutes apart, never learned to wait.
From their very first breath, a playful fight,
Two hearts colliding in fire and light.

Frenemies sworn since their earliest days,
Trading sharp words like a curious dance.
They bickered in laughter, in mock dismay,
Yet never knew love was growing that way.

At seven years old, when the world felt new,
Between stolen glances, their feelings grew.
In teasing remarks and a lingering stare,
Love found its home in the space they shared.

They argued like storms, then laughed like the sun,
Two restless souls always chasing, always one.
What started as rivalry, playful and wild,
Bloomed into forever, tender and styled.

So here’s to a love both fierce and true,
Born from chaos, yet perfectly you.
From frienemies first, to hearts intertwined,
A love written early, by fate well-timed.
